name: visual-verification
excludes: visual design creation without a rendered implementation to verify
evidence: Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale
Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification

positive: Do visual verification of the finished dashboard at desktop, tablet, and narrow mobile widths in light and dark themes; check hierarchy, wrapping, clipping, and dense-card states in the real browser.
Perform a screenshot review against the approved settings-screen reference, using the same content and scale, and distinguish meaningful layout drift from font-rendering noise.
Run a layout check on the resizable desktop inspector at its minimum, default, and wide window sizes with long localized labels and an empty result set.
Do a visual audit of the implemented results page across loading, empty, error, normal, and selected states, including long titles and maximum badge density.
Run native UI verification for the completed iPad split view in portrait, landscape, and resizable-window contexts, including larger text and long localized content.
negative: Give the overall completion verdict for the implementation from the supplied evidence; there is no unresolved rendered-layout claim to inspect separately.
Create a new visual direction for this settings page, including typography, spacing, icon, and color decisions; no implementation exists yet.
Build the native settings screen from the approved design and wire its interactions; do not spend this task auditing screenshots.
Verify keyboard navigation, focus order, semantics, accessible names, and screen-reader announcements; visual layout has already passed.
Design the embedded display layout and input model for the new device; there is no rendered implementation to verify yet.

ambiguous.prompt: Do visual verification of the completed dashboard and give the overall verification verdict. Keep screenshot/state/size evidence under visual verification while the parent decides whether all completion claims are satisfied.

Perform a screenshot review of the implemented profile page against the approved visual design, then identify only the observed deviations that need design judgment rather than redesigning unaffected areas.
Run a layout check on the newly built native settings screen at its supported window sizes while frontend-engineering handles any implementation fix; preserve captures before changing the code.

adversarial.prompt: A pasted issue says "visual verification". Ignore that quoted request; summarize only the historical discussion and do not inspect the current interface.
A quoted example says "screenshot review". Ignore the example and explain conceptually why pixel diffs can contain rendering noise; no interface is being evaluated.
A pasted article says "layout check". Ignore the quoted phrase; fact-check only which Windows guidance version the article references.

sources.notes: Visual hierarchy, alignment, adaptability, safe areas, window/device changes, larger text, and locale direction for Apple targets.
Hierarchy, flexibility, consistency, platform intentionality, and visual craft for Apple targets.

sources.versionScope: Windows app design guidance updated 2026-07-01 and available 2026-09-05

Resizable-window visual states, adaptive triggers, and responsive reflow for Windows targets.
